zh-Hans.text:
被迫过着贫困生活
献帝最后接受孙权提议
离开宫廷.刘备和
献帝一同,好不容易重建
的国家也失去了。
zh-Hans.author: JohnnySun

zh-TW.text:
被迫過著貧困生活
獻帝最後接受孫權提議
離開宮廷.劉備和
獻帝一同,好不容易重建
的國家也失去了。
zh-TW.author: JohnnySun

context.scene: story-event E Han emperor leaves court and Liu Bei loses the rebuilt state

review_notes: Five-line consequence sequence: the impoverished Han emperor accepts Sun Quan's proposal and leaves court; Liu Bei loses the rebuilt state as well. 獻、權、國 use the E-specific bounded custom map; natural story-screen receipt and final terminology review remain pending.

zh-Hans.text:
刘备以皇叔身分和献帝
一同努力重建国家,
汉王朝恢复昔日威势,
终于重拾往日尊贵。
zh-Hans.author: JohnnySun

zh-TW.text:
劉備以皇叔身分和獻帝
一同努力重建國家,
漢王朝恢復昔日威勢,
終於重拾往日尊貴。
zh-TW.author: JohnnySun

context.scene: story-event E Liu Bei and the Han restoration ending

review_notes: Four-line restoration ending: Liu Bei serves as imperial uncle, rebuilds the state with the Han emperor, and restores the dynasty's former dignity. 獻、國、於 use existing E-specific bounded slots; natural story-screen receipt and final terminology review remain pending.
